description: Client-side script for Work Order form in ERPNext, managing UI interactions, queries, and workflows for manufacturing work orders.

methods.name: set_custom_buttons
methods.description: Defines custom action buttons on the Work Order form based on status and conditions.

methods.name: change_work_order_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the work order to 'Closed', 'Stopped', or 'Resumed'.

methods.name: calculate_cost
methods.description: Calculates planned operating cost based on work order operations.

methods.name: calculate_total_cost
methods.description: Calculates total operating cost including additional costs.

methods.name: set_default_warehouse
methods.description: Sets default warehouses if not already specified.

methods.name: get_max_transferable_qty
methods.description: Returns maximum quantity transferable for manufacturing or other purposes.

methods.name: show_prompt_for_qty_input
methods.description: Prompts user to input quantity for transfer or creation purposes, with validation.

methods.name: make_se
methods.description: Creates a stock entry (Manufacture, Material Transfer, etc.) based on purpose.

methods.name: create_pick_list
methods.description: Creates a pick list for material transfer based on user input.

methods.name: make_consumption_se
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for material consumption during manufacturing.
